purpose: Develop expertise through annotated examples, critique and qualified review when available; no human career experience is claimed.
caseMatrix: Verified landing facts versus unavailable destination
Meta creative observations with no performance evidence
Narrow assignment with only one viable route
Format-only WHO versus actual customer situation
Exact destination URL and action proof versus homepage-only evidence
hardFailureCriteria: Predicted conversions or winning-ad assertion from library visibility
Customer hypothesis labeled as measured without eligible customer/campaign facts
Destination verified using evidence from a different page
qualitativeRubricAfterHardPass: Useful uncertainty and falsifiable evaluation hypothesis
reviewProcedure: Qualified reviewers independently annotate hard failures and concise reasons for preferences across supported routes. Preserve disagreements and source coverage. Multiple passes by the same model are not independent evidence. No reviewer score threshold or inter-rater performance is claimed yet.
improvementProcedure: Revise principles or examples when verified critique reveals a failure, version changes, rerun software regressions, and evaluate on held-out cases. Keep software checks, expert assessment and campaign outcomes as separate evidence classes.
futureOutcomeEvaluation: Where authorized and measurable, compare strategies with suitable controls and relevant measures. Account for audience, media, execution, destination and measurement differences; do not attribute outcomes solely to strategy without an adequate design.
